description.zh-Hans: 登录时显示详细的状态消息，便于排查启动问题。
description.en-US: Shows detailed status messages during sign-in for troubleshooting.

name.zh-Hans: 隐藏新版 Outlook 开关

description.zh-Hans: 隐藏 Outlook 里「试用新版 Outlook」的切换按钮。
description.en-US: Hides the Try the new Outlook toggle in classic Outlook.

description.zh-Hans: 滚动条不再自动隐藏，鼠标操作更直观。
description.en-US: Keeps scrollbars visible instead of hiding them when idle.

description.zh-Hans: 关闭 MPO，可缓解部分显卡的闪烁与黑屏，但会增加一点功耗。
description.en-US: Disables MPO, which can fix flicker or black screens on some GPUs at a small power cost.

name.zh-Hans: 阻止在线获取设备配套应用

description.zh-Hans: 插上设备时不再自动从 Windows 更新下载厂商配套应用。
description.en-US: Prevents Windows Update from fetching vendor companion apps when a device is connected.

description.zh-Hans: 关闭定位服务并禁用地图数据自动更新。
description.en-US: Turns off location services and automatic map data updates.

name.zh-Hans: Brave 浏览器去广告与遥测

description.zh-Hans: 关闭 Brave 奖励、钱包、VPN、统计上报等策略项。
description.en-US: Disables Brave Rewards, Wallet, VPN, telemetry and related policy features.

description.zh-Hans: 关闭 Edge 的购物、推荐、遥测等策略项。
description.en-US: Disables Edge shopping, recommendations, telemetry and related policies.

description.zh-Hans: 在资源管理器导航栏中隐藏「主页」与「图库」。
description.en-US: Hides Home and Gallery from File Explorer navigation.

description.zh-Hans: 调低 IPv6 前缀优先级，双栈时优先走 IPv4。
description.en-US: Lowers IPv6 prefix priority so dual-stack connections prefer IPv4.

description.zh-Hans: 关闭系统托盘的通知中心与日历弹出。
description.en-US: Disables the notification center and calendar flyout.

description.zh-Hans: 把硬件时钟当作 UTC（双系统用户常用）。
description.en-US: Treats the hardware clock as UTC, common on dual-boot systems.

description.zh-Hans: 停止自动清理与云内容按需下载策略。
description.en-US: Disables automatic cleanup and cloud content dehydration policies.

name.zh-Hans: 关闭 RDP 未签名文件警告

description.zh-Hans: 不再提示远程桌面中的未签名文件，安全性会降低。
description.en-US: Stops warning about unsigned files in Remote Desktop; lowers security.

description.zh-Hans: 登录界面使用纯色背景，减少 GPU 开销。
description.en-US: Uses a solid background on the sign-in screen to reduce GPU work.

description.zh-Hans: 打开设置时直接进入上次的页面。
description.en-US: Opens Settings directly to the last page instead of Home.

description.zh-Hans: 现代待机（S0）期间保持网络连接。
description.en-US: Keeps the network connected during modern standby (S0).

description.zh-Hans: 拖动窗口到屏幕边缘时自动贴靠。
description.en-US: Snaps windows when dragged to screen edges.

description.zh-Hans: 阻止固件通过 Windows Platform Binary Table 在系统中植入程序。
description.en-US: Blocks firmware from injecting binaries through the Windows Platform Binary Table.
